utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m ready to help with the repair drive—what do you need me to take on?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Mara — could you handle the sign-up sheet and check-in table? I’ll bring the tools and join once I finish up next door.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’ll set up the sign-up sheet and cover the check-in table. See you when you get here.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can help with the repair drive. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Leo — I’m checking the details first. Can you tell me what tools you have and when you’re free?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’ve got a basic toolbox, a drill, and a ladder. I’m free most evenings after 6, and this weekend morning works too.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can keep an eye on what we’ve got and note any supplies we still need for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: That’d be great, thanks, Cleo. I might miss a few things, so I appreciate you keeping track.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Absolutely — I’ll jot down anything we’re short on and let you know. Just tell me what gets used, and I’ll keep the list updated.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with that—what’s being repaired, and what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Rey. I’m worried we’ll need to move a few things first, and I’m not sure who can bring the tools.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can bring the tools if you tell me what you need moved. Just point me to the time and place, and I’ll do my part.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hey Nell, is the repair drive still on for Saturday? I can bring tools if you need them.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I’m not sure yet — I’ve only heard second-hand updates. Let me check and I’ll let you know about Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sounds good—can you let me know as soon as you hear? I can still bring my tools if it’s happening.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, right—the repair drive. I haven’t heard any fresh updates yet, but I’ll keep my ears open and let you know if anything comes through.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Tess — I appreciate that. If you hear anything, just give me a shout and I can lend a hand.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely, Gus — I’ll do that. If anything comes up, I’ll give you a shout right away.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, I’m definitely telling folks about the repair drive—everyone on the block should know about it. I’ll spread the word as fast as I can!

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Quinn — I’ll keep an eye on who’s heard about it and where it’s posted.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll mention it to anyone I bump into and make sure the word gets around the block.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm you’re free on Saturday morning?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yes, I’m free Saturday morning and can help with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ll help keep the repair drive organized and make sure we’ve got everything lined up.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, thanks Rosa — just keep me posted on what you need from me.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Will do, Bo — I’ll send you a short list of what I need and keep you updated as things come together.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll spread the word about the repair drive and make sure folks know what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Vik. Let’s keep it simple: a short note with the date, the needed items, and where people can drop them off.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll put together a short note with the date, the needed items, and the drop-off spot, then I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive — sorry, I’m a bit scattered today. I’m happy to help; what do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Oren. If you could bring a hammer and a couple of screwdrivers, that would help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: You got it — hammer and a couple screwdrivers. I’ll swing by with them for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m glad the repair drive is coming together — I can help introduce folks if you want.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That’d be great, Jules — introductions would really help get people there. I’ll let you know what else we need.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — just send me the names, and I’ll help make the introductions. I’m happy to do whatever I can to get more neighbors involved.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Dane, just spreading the word—the repair drive’s coming up soon. If you’re free, I’d love to have you stop by and help out.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good, Quinn — I’ll try to swing by if I can make it.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Awesome, thanks Dane — I’ll keep you posted with the details. Hope you can make it!

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m happy to help out with the repair drive. What do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Rey—could you bring a sturdy hammer, a screwdriver set, and some work gloves? If you can, come by around 10 so we can get started right away.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can bring those and be there around 10.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help with that, but I need the repair drive details first. What do you want me to share with Mara?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Please share the repair drive date, time, and where people should drop things off. If there’s a list of needed items, include that too.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I don’t have those details yet—can you send me the date, time, drop-off spot, and the needed items list?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sounds good — I can help link everyone up for the repair drive. What do you need from me first?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Jules — first I need you to help get the neighbor list together so we know who to contact. After that, we can figure out the pickup times and where everyone should meet.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll start putting the neighbor list together and then we can map out the pickup times and meeting spot.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can lend a hand if you need any tools for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Gus — I might take you up on that if I can figure out the timing and what we still need.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No rush at all—just let me know when you’ve got the list and I’ll see what I can spare.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can keep track of the repair drive spots for us—just tell me the locations and I’ll note them down.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Opal — that would be a huge help. I’ll send you the locations as I confirm them.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Perfect — send them whenever you have them, and I’ll keep the list organized.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Have you confirmed what’s being repaired first, Hana?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Not yet—I want to double-check the list first so I don’t get it wrong. I’ll confirm the first repair and tell you right away.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Okay, please do—just let me know the first repair as soon as you confirm it.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can help out with the repair drive—what do you need me to bring or do?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Could you bring the tape, a couple screwdrivers, and any spare batteries you’ve got? If you can also help sort the donations when you arrive, that’d be a huge help.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’ll bring the tape, screwdrivers, and spare batteries, and I can help sort donations when I get there.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I haven’t heard the latest on the repair drive yet — what’s the update?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, I might’ve missed the latest—did they say when it’s starting?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m not sure either — I only heard it’s still in the planning stage. If I get an update, I’ll let you know.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, the repair drive is still happening, right?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, it’s still happening — nothing’s changed on that front. I’ll let you know if I hear any new details.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Got it — thanks for confirming. I’ll keep an eye out for updates.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Ira. I really appreciate that.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: No problem — I’ll let you know if I hear anything useful.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive. I was meaning to check what still needs doing; I can help with that if you need me.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Oren — could you check the list and tell me what’s still left? That’d really help.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yeah, absolutely — I’ll go look at the list and see what’s still left. I’ll get back to you in a bit.
